lead.description: a record in which a lifetime is known only to exceed a time, or to fall inside an interval, rather than known exactly

self_checks.title: Product-limit value
self_checks.prompt: Five units: one failure at time 2, a censoring at time 3, and two failures at time 5. What is the product-limit estimate at time 5?

self_checks.title: Censoring becomes a failure
self_checks.prompt: If the time-3 observation is a failure instead, what is the product-limit estimate at time 5?
